title: The admin's own session
caption: Cookies of admin.platform.example.com (all HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, Path=/). The access token lives 15 minutes, the refresh token 2 idle hours inside a 12-hour family (platform/backend/src/admin/admin-auth.service.ts); the step-up window is 15 minutes.

states.label: signed out
states.detail: No `__Host-vxa_*` cookie; every page but `/sign-in`, `/sign-in/mfa`, `/sign-out` answers 303 to `/sign-in?next=…`.

states.label: signed in, step-up fresh
states.detail: Token `mfa_at` within 15 min: step-up operations pass without a dialog.

states.label: signed in, step-up stale
states.detail: Step-up operations answer `401 REAUTH_REQUIRED`; StepUpDialog asks for a code.

states.label: ended
states.detail: Family revoked (sign-out, rights revoked, account disabled, refresh reuse) or 12 h / 2 h idle passed: cookies deleted, back to sign-in.
